single_biggest_risk.assumption: That the LCK is clearly the strongest region: +0.65 logit over the LPL (worth about 65-35 per game between otherwise equal teams), with a standard error of 0.60, so the gap is only about one standard error from zero. It rests on 2025's results (used as a prior) plus LCK's 14-2 and 9-0 game records against the LCS and LCP in 2026, while the direct LCK-LPL record is 5-5 in series. The predicted champion and three of the four semifinalists depend on it.
single_biggest_risk.early_detection: Swiss rounds 1-3 (Bo1s from 23/10) give the first same-patch cross-region evidence. If LPL teams win the majority of LCK-LPL meetings, or Gen.G drops a Bo1 to a Tier 4 team, the staged Swiss re-run should shrink the gap. The region-gap standard error is on the Overview tab.

At his 2026 rate of 3.61 kills per game that is about 24 games (wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)), close to the maximum a team can play at Worlds (roughly 26 for a champion going the distance in long series).

crystal_ball.question: Will more games end before or after 32:00?
crystal_ball.reason: 52.1% of 2026 games by Worlds teams ended before 32:00 even though the average is 32:21 (wards.lol 2026 stats for the 19 Worlds teams, 1,590 games (https://wards.lol/lol-esports/pick-ems/2026/worlds/, accessed 15/10/2026)): game length is right-skewed, so the median sits below the mean.

crystal_ball.question: Will any pro get 15+ kills in one game?
